metadata.description: EssayOS, an idempotent, stateful, agentic operating system for writing application essays, plus optional standalone installs of the two writing skills it bundles.

plugins.name: essayos
plugins.description: Idempotent, stateful, agentic OS for writing application essays such as college admissions, scholarship and grant applications, graduate school statements, fellowships, and job letters. Builds the essay from the applicant's real experiences and verifies every claim. Ingests an essay you already wrote and proposes revisions in your voice. Portable Markdown and YAML; runnable by Claude or Codex.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Optional standalone install of blader/humanizer, pinned to the same commit essayos ships in skills/humanizer. Not required: essayos carries its own copy.

plugins.name: simple-english
plugins.description: Optional standalone install of AminBlg/SimpleEnglish, pinned to the same commit essayos ships in skills/simple-english. Not required: essayos carries its own copy. Note: the upstream plugin adds write-time lint hooks.
